snippet.title: My Second Game: Minor Deity Pre-Alpha Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3876240/Minor_Deity/
Discord: https://discord.gg/2NEb4HxwhF

Command Earth, Water, Air and Fire to create the landscapes of your dreams, from tiny single islands to networks of variable landmasses, to large continents. Control dynamic localized weather to allow a variety of vegetation and herds of animals to survive, and even flourish. Lay out towns to house growing populations, establish outposts to gather resources, and encourage trade via road, river and sea routes. Enjoy the freedom of grid-less building and cement your reputation in the halls of the Minor Deities.

I've been working on Minor Deity for 16 months after publishing World Turtles.
